author: codex-demand-rule
about: A LibreChat user selects cohere in the shipped web-search feature and supplies their own in-app key. Web search ships enabled (packages/data-provider/src/config.ts:2421); users choose providers and save their own key (packages/api/src/web/web.ts:386-402,476-482). No operator step is required.

steps.name: The World issues the application's Cohere key
LibreChat reranks the scraped studio page about vinyasa classes

steps.name: The customer returns the next day
The World resumes with the same application key
